items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I think Bonnie somebody talked over to going the plane again.

ctx.x: And as far as the government was concerned, they still had to hold it. So I wrote in for an application for Douglas, at the Center of Monica, and I received it and through there they sent me over there. And I worked for Douglas two years, up until just before the war ended, in the meantime, I made up a band out of the plant. I had two girls and a six piece band and everybody said, what the devil are you doing here? Like you can play. And I said, well the government still got a hold of him. Well we used to let us…
Yeah. When Ory first got his band together working for those radio arson wells, you know, they had Zutty. Yeah, that's right. You were in the factory then.
